source_notes.label: Source-proposed LSS mechanism
source_notes.summary: The authors describe ion exchange from aqueous metal ions into solid metal linoleate, interfacial reaction, hydrophobic fatty-acid-associated surfaces and spontaneous separation. Figure 3 is their mechanistic scheme, not measured molecular or particle coordinates. Its reduction-by-ethanol step applies to noble metals; other material families use different interfacial chemistry.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1, LSS mechanism and Figure 3

source_notes.label: Noble-metal quantities have bounded scope
source_notes.summary: The typical noble-metal recipe specifies 20 mL aqueous salt solution with an example 0.5 g salt charge, 1.6 g sodium linoleate, 10 mL ethanol and 2 mL linoleic acid in a 40 mL autoclave, sealed for 10 h. AgNO3 and HAuCl4 are named; other soluble chlorides are unspecified. No hydration state or exact salt identity is added. Other fatty acids and corresponding salts are stated alternatives, not extra quantified runs.

source_notes.label: Ranges are not a series of invented experiments
source_notes.summary: Source family temperatures are Ag 80–200 °C; Ru/Rh/Ir 20–200 °C; Au/Pd/Pt 20–100 °C. Ag/Au diameter can vary about 4–15 nm, and Ru/Rh/Ir/Pd/Pt are about 3 nm or less. Specific Figure 1 captions retain their own means, uncertainty and temperature. SI tuning series were not reviewed.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1–2, Noble metals and Figure 1a

source_notes.label: Different non-noble reactions retain missing inputs
source_notes.summary: The source names sulfide from Na2S or (NH4)2S, selenide from SeO3(2−) reduced by N2H4, and fluoride from NaF or NH4F. Figure captions supply selected ratios and temperatures. Unassigned alternatives remain unresolved and the noble-metal 10 h/liquid charges are not transferred. Barium titanate alone has the stated 7 g NaOH, 0.5 g Ba(NO3)2 and equal TiCl3 moles; TiO2 has 1 mL 30% TiCl3 for a 40 mL vessel.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1–2, Material families and Figure 1 caption

source_notes.label: Hierarchical sizes and source discrepancies
source_notes.summary: YF3 rice-like assemblies are approximately 100 nm across and 500 nm long, composed of approximately 5 nm nanocrystals. The NaYF4/LaF3/YbF3 family range 4–12 nm and Ln(OH)3 nanorod diameters 3–15 nm vary with temperature and do not become extra specimen means. CoFe2O4 caption 11.5±0.6 nm is retained separately from the prose approximation of about 10 nm.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2–3, Figure 1 caption and morphology discussion

source_notes.label: Characterization and processing context
source_notes.summary: TEM-grid assembly occurs after solvent evaporation; original image scales are not size averages. Figure 2 CdS is not the Figure 1 CdSe specimen. Cyclohexane/chloroform dispersions are usually stable for months; Figure 4 calls 2% a typical concentration without specifying percentage basis. Drop/dip coating, ethanol reprecipitation and external-field separation are qualitative downstream possibilities, without exact dose/schedule or new synthesis measurements.
